goal: The fw/flywheel CLI gains a docs verb that prints each of the nine curated operator docs byte-identical to the canonical docs/ sources from any working directory, lists exactly those topics when called bare, and exits non-zero naming any unknown topic.

graders.name: parity-from-anywhere
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && cd "$(mktemp -d)" && for t in cli configuration task-schema workflow loop strategy sandbox autopilot held-out-gate; do uv run --project "$WT" flywheel docs "$t" > "$t.out" || exit 1; cmp -s "$t.out" "$WT/docs/$t.md" || { echo "parity fail: $t"; exit 1; }; done

graders.name: bare-listing
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && cd "$(mktemp -d)" && uv run --project "$WT" flywheel docs > list.out && for t in cli configuration task-schema workflow loop strategy sandbox autopilot held-out-gate; do grep -q "^$t " list.out || { echo "missing topic: $t"; exit 1; }; done && test "$(grep -cE '^[a-z][a-z-]* ' list.out)" -eq 9

graders.name: unknown-topic
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && cd "$(mktemp -d)" && if uv run --project "$WT" flywheel docs no-such-topic >out.txt 2>err.txt; then echo 'unknown topic exited 0'; exit 1; fi && grep -q 'no-such-topic' err.txt && ! test -s out.txt

graders.name: parity-harness-discriminates
graders.run: TMP=$(mktemp) && mv docs/loop.md "$TMP" && if uv run pytest packages/flywheel/tests/test_docs_parity.py -q >/dev/null 2>&1; then mv "$TMP" docs/loop.md; echo 'parity harness passed with a missing source doc'; exit 1; else mv "$TMP" docs/loop.md; fi

relevant: packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_cli.py -- the fw/flywheel verb router the docs verb joins
packages/flywheel/pyproject.toml -- packaging; the curated docs ship as package data of this dist
docs/README.md -- source of one-line topic descriptions for the bare listing
packages/flywheel/tests/test_docs_parity.py -- NEW: the parity harness; must iterate the canonical topic-set constant against docs/<topic>.md and fail loudly on a missing source
constraints: Expose the curated topic set as ONE importable constant in the flywheel package; the listing, the serving path, and the parity test must all consume it -- no local copies
Serve content from package data (importlib.resources) embedded from the canonical docs/*.md at build time -- never re-authored prose, never a path resolved outside the installed package
The verb must work with no flywheel.toml present (docs are knowledge, not policy; no policy load)
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify the content of any existing docs/*.md to make parity pass
Do not weaken or delete existing tests; do not special-case topic names inside the parity test
Do not add an MCP server or any always-on context surface (spec 00072 D-1)
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A renamed or deleted source doc must fail the parity harness naming the topic (spec criterion 4)
Bare listing and per-topic serving must not drift: both derive from the same constant
